build_task_with_define_task: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE task
create_box_with_add_box: call C.add_box(width, height) to create a box body in the PHYRE scene
position_box_with_set_bottom: chain set_bottom and set_left on a box to position it in the scene
define_spatial_relationship_task: use C.update_task with SpatialRelationship.RIGHT_OF to define a spatial reasoning task
review_build_task_function: review the build_task function to understand how boxes and spatial relationships are configured
